hypothesis.feature: 10*log10(sum(pre-suppression speech-band power) / sum(updated per-bin NS noise estimate))
hypothesis.speech_band: exact existing NS evidence band: k > nfft/64 and k < 7*nfft/16
hypothesis.floor_invariance: power and NS per-bin noise estimates are computed before floor_gain is applied, so the aggregate spectral SNR must be identical at ns_floor 0.12 and 0.05
hypothesis.information_test: ROC AUC against existing VAD labels is threshold-free and tests whether the spectral aggregate carries more speech/noise information than current NS speech_probability
hypothesis.relationship_to_rejected_scalar_route: The rejected direct scalar local-SNR replacement used frame RMS against one calibrated aggregate NS noise metric and lost about 0.30-0.33 recall absolute on every fresh partition. This diagnostic does not emulate that VAD mapping; it tests only whether preserved spectral structure contains additional information.

decision_contract.NS_SPECTRAL_POST_SNR_INFORMATION_GAIN_SU: Floor invariance holds, combined and per-seed spectral-SNR AUC gates pass, and the combined AUC gain over current NS speech_probability meets the preregistered minimum.
decision_contract.NS_SPECTRAL_POST_SNR_INFORMATION_GAIN_NO: Input/floor invariants hold but one or more preregistered information-gain gates fail.
decision_contract.NS_SPECTRAL_POST_SNR_INPUT_INVALID_REVIE: Exact source/seed binding, geometry, finite-value, or floor-invariance preconditions fail.

next_review: Only threshold-free information gain may be reviewed. Any VAD fusion mapping, adaptive-state guard, threshold, or source candidate requires a separate preregistered hypothesis and entirely new authority.
